# NestTech Support

> 1-to-1 IT support for homes and small businesses across London. Direct, jargon-free help delivered by the same dedicated engineer every time, no call centres, no ticket queues.

NestTech Support is a sole-trader IT support business run by Tim, covering Greater London (zones 1-5) with remote support available UK-wide.

## Services
- Home & Family IT: Wi-Fi installation, device setup, everyday troubleshooting
- Business & SME Support: ongoing or one-off IT cover for small and home-based businesses
- Security Services: cybersecurity assessments, antivirus, firewalls
- Cloud & Data: backup strategy, cloud storage, data recovery
- Smart Home & Office: smart device integration, home-office setup

## Pricing
- Remote support: from £45
- On-site visits: from £75
- Free, no-obligation quote before any work begins

## Coverage
- Zones 1-2: Central London
- Zones 2-3: Inner London
- Zones 4-5: Outer London
- Remote support: UK-wide
